name: Trail Radio
subtitle: A little pocket prairie
promotionalText: A warm, green-glowing soundscape for quiet moments. Make your own mix of wind, hoofbeats, wagon creaks, and distant birds—entirely offline.
description:
A little pocket prairie.

Trail Radio brings the gentle rhythm of the trail to your iPhone and iPad: warm, bass-rich wind, soft hoofbeats, a creaking wagon, and birds in the distance.

MAKE YOUR MIX
Adjust each sound independently, from a quiet wind-only bed to the full rolling-wagon soundscape. Your sound levels are remembered on your device.

TAKE IT ANYWHERE
Sounds are generated on your device. No streaming, downloads, or internet reception needed for playback.

KEEP LISTENING
Play with your screen locked and use lock-screen play/pause controls. Set an optional sleep timer, or leave it off for continuous playback.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
A green monochrome interface. No account, ads, subscriptions, analytics, or tracking.

Use a comfortable listening level. Trail Radio is an ambience app and does not provide medical treatment.
reviewNotes: No login is required. Tap Take the Trail to start audio; it becomes Rest a While while playing. Each sound layer has an independent slider. Scroll down for the optional sleep timer and Privacy & Support. Background audio is a core feature: start playback and lock the device to continue listening. All audio is synthesized on-device; no content downloads or network access are required. The app does not record audio or request microphone access.
